svg.title: Vadhyar proposed focused prediction lesson
svg.desc: Static proposed Vadhyar design for a same-computer loopback browser. SeatCheck example content; no live learner record, executed check or phone connectivity.
svg.text: What happens with no seats left?
Make a prediction before observing the case.
Rule: no seats remaining must block a booking.
What in the code led you there?
I expect the booking to be blocked because there are no seats.
You can change this draft until you save it.
